title: Explain technical work visually
statement: As an architect, I can explain technical work through ordered visual slides whose semantic elements reference exact code so reviewers can understand the system without reconstructing it from a file diff.
overview:
An implementation deck explains a mechanism through an authored technical overview, short summary Fronts and detailed visual Backs. Semantic Items connect the explanation to exact code. The purpose is to make responsibilities, transitions and tradeoffs inspectable rather than turning a file list into a slide tour.

Application-wide design now starts with the [approach essay and three whiteboards](/technical). A feature deck can reference that shared design while retaining its narrower implementation account. A pull-request review deck explains a transition; neither a whiteboard pin nor an overview citation substitutes for Item code evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A deck accepts SVG, raster-image, and sandboxed HTML slides.
An addressable slide element can reference an exact source location pinned to a commit.
